question: Can the current pure-visual sparse Schur solver run global rig BA below 2 GiB and close the remaining COLMAP trajectory gap?

ten_k_full_post_deferred_global.termination: external VmRSS monitor sent SIGTERM after crossing 2 GiB

growth_global_ba_500_1000_2000_4000.diagnosis: COLMAP-style geometric growth solves stay below 2 GiB, but moving the active gauge during incremental registration changes later PnP outcomes, loses six images, and amplifies repeated-corridor outliers; the opt-in API and CLI were removed

conclusion: The sparse Schur implementation removes the historical 14 GiB global-BA failure and passes the frozen 1k gate. At 10k, globally re-solving after deferred track growth still exceeds 2 GiB. Solving only the established base and returning post-deferred refinement to 60-frame windows stays bounded but worsens trajectory. A separate COLMAP-style 500/1000/2000/4000-frame growth schedule also stays at 1.55 GiB, yet loses six registrations and regresses RMSE/p95 to 0.81762/1.35665 m. Reprojection-only global BA is not the missing inter-segment gauge constraint; both experimental scheduling controls were removed.
